name: lac10
label: 10 Lac (O9 V)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-11-09) and the papers it cites: V 4.880, B-V -0.210, O9 V, T_eff 34550 K, R 7.4 Rsun, M 21.6 Msun, log g 4.04, v sin i 14 km/s, Gaia parallax 2.192 +/- 0.131 mas (552 +/- 32 pc)
Gordon et al. 2018, ApJ 869, 37 (CHARA/PAVO, 650-800 nm, S1E1): theta_LD 0.11 +/- 0.02 mas, the smallest diameter CHARA has measured (below PAVO's nominal 0.2 mas limit)
R. Kaiser (INPHYNI), email to P. Nugent 2026-11-09 ('Targets La Palma'): requested target
notes: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.125 mas from the quoted radius and distance, consistent with CHARA's 0.11 +/- 0.02. First null 1.22 lambda/theta = 840 m at 417 nm (955 m for 0.11 mas).
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
MK standard O9 V; suspected beta Cep variable. An 8th-magnitude companion at ~1 arcmin is outside any field stop.
